mechanism: Additive anticholinergic effects from oxybutynin combined with serotonergic activity of citalopram, plus potential CYP3A4/2D6 competition affecting citalopram metabolism.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic toxicity (dry mouth, urinary retention, confusion, tachycardia); consider alternative antimuscarinic agents with less CNS penetration or dose adjustment; baseline ECG recommended given citalopram's QT prolongation risk.
